title: Laredo Utilities Closed Thanksgiving Day and Friday; Water and Sewer Emergencies Call 3-1-1
excerpt: The City of Laredo Utilities Department will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, in observance of Thanksgiving. Normal business hours resume Monda
content:
The City of Laredo Utilities Department will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, in observance of Thanksgiving.

Normal business hours resume Monday, Nov. 30.

Residents with a water or sewer emergency during the closure should call 3-1-1.

The department wished residents and their families a safe and happy Thanksgiving.

Source: City of Laredo Utilities Department.
